intro: Welcome to MyYatra, your travel story across Nepal. Here's how to use the app, in twelve quick steps.
outro: That's MyYatra. Mark your first district, and start your yatra.
01_welcome: Open the app and tap Get started.
02_signup: Add your name, email and a password, accept the privacy policy, and create your account.
03_interests: Next, tell MyYatra what you love. Choose as many kinds of places as you like. This starts your Journey DNA.
04_style: Then answer a few questions about how often you travel, your style, and who you go with.
05_plan: Set your usual budget, how far you're happy to go, and your favourite season.
06_visited: Finally, tick any districts you've already visited, and tap Finish setup.
07_home: Your home screen shows your footprint across Nepal, your Journey DNA, and fresh picks every week.
08_explore: In Explore, search all seventy-seven districts, or filter them by province.
09_district: Tap a district to see the best season, the cost, how to get there, and local festivals and food.
10_mark: Been there? Tap Mark visited, and choose the date of your trip.
11_places: Add the places you went, and tag what you did at each one.
12_visited_card: Your visit now shows on the district page, ready to edit any time.
13_safety: Every district has safety notes, emergency numbers, and a quick check-in to say you're safe.
14_review: Share your experience with a star rating and a short review.
15_review_done: Your review is published for other travellers to read.
16_offline: And save the district for offline, so it's there even without signal.
17_itinerary: Planning a trip? Create an itinerary with dates, a budget and your companions, then fill in each day.
18_map: The footprint map colours every district: visited, recommended, or not yet explored.
19_foryou: For you ranks the districts that fit your DNA and plans, and tells you why. Give a thumbs up or down to tune them.
20_dna: Journey DNA turns your interests and visits into a traveller type, with scores across six categories.
21_gaps: Gap analysis shows what you haven't explored yet, and which provinces to try next.
22_journal_form: Keep a journal. Write about each trip, with dates, a story and photos.
23_journal: All your entries and your travel history live in one tab.
24_stats: And statistics track your districts, provinces and journeys over time.
25_profile: Your profile brings it all together: your DNA, badges, itineraries and downloads.
26_badges: Earn badges as you travel, and take on district challenges.
